name: Futuristic Solutions Limited
summary: Futuristic Solutions Ltd. operates as a non-banking financial company, which engages in the industry that deals with debts, claims, arbitration, distressed land and properties. It provides futuristic solutions of arbitration cases, recovery of disputed debts, purchase, sale, discounting and dealing in actionable claims, disputed debts, and recoverable debts. The company was founded on September 23, 1983 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
